title: finding(fields,plugin-form): the line-items family's last English under zh — GridField's invalid-cell "LABEL is required" and MasterDetailForm's three config hints
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (a). `reach:` a public door, measured: the record page's master-detail form and its line-items grid, rendered under zh.
- **Measured.** The objectui#11145 dev ran an uncommitted zh probe (deleted after, tree clean) at PR objectui#11159's head `b7b0a5795`.
  - `GridField` with an empty required cell: in the same render the Add button read `添加行`, while the invalid cell's `title` read `Qty is required`.
  - `MasterDetailForm` with a detail declaring no `childObject`: the heading read `明细行`, while the `md-detail-no-child-object` hint read `This collection has no child object configured…`.
- **Confirmed at source.** PR objectui#11159's contract review (`5901850270`, ③ out-of-scope (a) and (b)) confirmed every site below at that head. All of them are pre-existing: no hunk of that PR touches them.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11159 (objectui#11145, which closed out the line-items chrome family), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[1]` (`5901703533`). The review proposed one remainder card for the family, so this is one card that enumerates every site. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites (line numbers at `b7b0a5795`; re-read them by content after PR objectui#11159 lands)

**`packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`.** The invalid-cell text is built as `${c.label || c.name} is required`, an English literal, at three sites:
1. the plain cell's `title` (`:1342`);
2. the lookup cell's `error` prop (`:1105`);
3. the file cell's `error` prop (`:1125`).

`validation.required` (`{{field}} is required`) already exists in every pack, so reuse is the obvious read, but that is triage's call.

**`packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`.** Three configuration hints are English literals:
4. `md-detail-no-child-object` (`:744`), which was measured. This is the twin of `LineItemsPanel`'s hint, which PR objectui#11159 translated as `form.lineItems.noChildObject` with a `{{property}}` split that keeps `childObject` a code element. The twin's sentence says "collection" where the panel's says "panel", so whether it reuses the key or gets a new one is triage's call;
5. `md-detail-schema-unavailable` (`:765`), read in source;
6. `md-detail-no-relationship-field` (`:788`), read in source.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- `GridField` reads the required text through `useFieldTranslation` (the table PR objectui#11159 extended), reusing `validation.required` with `{{field}}` set to the column label.
- `MasterDetailForm` reads the three hints through `useFormChromeTranslation` (`formChrome.ts`). A hint that names a property keeps it a code element through the `{{property}}` split.
- Pins:
  - a zh render of each of the six sites;
  - an en control, byte-equal;
  - a server or authored message unchanged, where a site has one.

## Dedupe

The line-items chrome family is objectui#11131 (PR objectui#11143) and objectui#11145 (PR objectui#11159). Neither names these six sites. objectui#11145's card body lists its sites, and none is a validation message or a `MasterDetailForm` config hint. The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (down to #10369, fetched before PR objectui#11159 opened) were grepped for `md-detail-no-child-object`, `md-detail-schema-unavailable`, `md-detail-no-relationship-field`, and `is required` within 200 characters of `GridField`: 0 hits each. No card covers this.
